name: Laguna Esmeralda
region: Tierra Mayor valley, Tierra del Fuego
why: The most-walked trail near Ushuaia: lenga forest, a beaver-dammed peat bog and an emerald lake under the Albino glacier.
book: Free. Minibuses leave from Ushuaia's port road; the trailhead is 19 km north on Ruta 3.
dangers: Deep mud in the peat bog after rain: waterproof boots or you will be wet to the ankle.
Weather turns fast: carry a warm layer even in January.

points.name: Laguna Esmeralda trailhead, Ruta 3
